💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nightlight: Never wade in. The glow is a mouth — it waits for you to come close. Never wade in. Strike the light from two squares out and it's just a fish with a lamp. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (You lived to tell it — twice — and now you see the pattern.)
